listing.name: No One Can Stop Mr. Domino — DominoRecomp (nikeymikey)
listing.original_game_title: No One Can Stop Mr. Domino
listing.summary: Experimental MrDomino source project. Upstream reports correct-speed startup and native overlay caching across six stages, but the game remains incomplete. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-00804 MrDomino disc in CUE form, with OpenBIOS or your own SCPH1001 BIOS. Keep your original files separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow scripts/build_windows.ps1 to generate and compile the game. Captured overlays compile with MinGW GCC. Prepare and build the game yourself; Portcove does not install it automatically and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: Upstream reports correct-speed startup and native overlay caching across six stages. The project still interprets 77 instructions per frame and is incomplete. Portcove has not confirmed those runtime or gameplay claims.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
